name: Keyideas Jewelry Customizer – Diamond Ring Builder & Engagement Rings for WooCommerce
author: Keyideas Infotech Private Limited

sections.description:
Keyideas Jewelry Customizer adds a 3-step ring builder to WooCommerce. Shoppers choose a diamond or gemstone, pair it with one of your ring settings, pick their ring size and buy the finished ring through your usual WooCommerce checkout.

Activate it, choose the stones you offer and your ring collection, and the diamond listing, detail and review pages are created for you. It works with any WordPress theme and suits jewellery stores of every size, from independent jewellers to diamond retailers.

Free Demo | Documentation | Video Tutorials

Features

  • Build Your Own Ring – start with a stone or a ring setting; the review page shows both with the total price and the ring size
  • Ring, earring and pendant builders – sell fine jewellery beyond rings: matched earring pairs and pendant settings, in the same steps
  • Diamond search – natural, lab-grown and colored diamonds and gemstones, with shape, carat, color, clarity, cut and price filters, grid or list view, compare and recently viewed
  • Diamond detail pages – 360° view, grading certificate, a diamond viewer that shows the stone on a hand, and carat, cut, color and clarity guides
  • Feed Center – set margins by price or carat, add discounts and choose which inventory is live
  • Your own stones – import diamonds and gemstones with a CSV file and sell them in the same ring builder
  • Sales dashboard – stones sold, revenue, profit and monthly trends
  • Appearance – brand colors and typography, with a private preview before you save
  • Language & Region – English (US/UK), French, German, Italian and Spanish storefronts, editable text and your region’s ring sizes
  • WooCommerce – complete rings and loose stones in the cart; each order shows the stone’s stock number and the setting
  • SEO and speed – diamond products are noindex, listing pages are cached, mobile-ready and HPOS compatible

Shortcodes

The plugin creates its pages on activation. To place them yourself:

  • [KIRB-RingBuilder-Listing category="NATURAL"] – diamond listing; category NATURAL, LAB CREATED, GEMSTONE or COLORED DIAMONDS
  • [KIRB-RingBuilder-DetailPage] – diamond detail page
  • [KIRB-RingBuilder-BYORPage] – ring review page
  • [KIRB-RingBuilder-BYORStrip] – the 3-step ring builder bar
  • [KIRB-RingBuilder-SettingButton] – the “Choose This Setting” button

Plans: Free vs Pro

Every store starts on Free, which never expires. The Pro plans are Basic ($49/month billed yearly, or $69 monthly), Standard ($99/month yearly, or $119 monthly) and Premium ($121/month yearly, or $145 monthly). To upgrade, use Contact Us in the plugin.

  • Nivoda diamonds (Nivoda account needed) – Free: sample diamonds / Pro: 50%, 70% or 100%
  • Your own imported diamonds – Free: 30% / Pro: 50%, 70% or 100%
  • Ask AI messages a month – Free: 20 / Pro: 40, 60 or 100
  • Keyideas logo – Free: shown / Basic and Standard: removable ($330 or $230 one-time) / Premium: no logo
  • Advanced CSS – Free: no / Pro: on yearly plans
  • Every plan – ring, earring and pendant builders, AI diamond score, diamond suppliers, grid view on mobile and redacted certificate PDFs; show/hide filters and engraving free for a limited time

Add-ons such as the Product Library (100+ ring designs with 360° videos) and Custom Supplier Integration (RapNet, VDB and others) can be added on any plan.

More From Keyideas

Keyideas Jewelry Filter and Search for fast filters across every jewellery type, Vizora – 3D Try-On for trying on jewellery with augmented reality, Jewelith – 3D Design Studio for real-time 3D jewellery design, and Timenox for luxury watches.

Support

Use Contact Us in the plugin, book a free consultation or email sales@keyideasinfotech.com. Help translate the plugin at translate.wordpress.org.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following services. No data is sent until the plugin is activated and set up by a site administrator.

Keyideas RingBuilder API (https://engagement-ring-builder-o4hk8.kinsta.app)
Provides the diamond and gemstone inventory, prices, product details and recommendations shown in the ring builder until the store is connected to the Keyideas RingBuilder app (see below), and the sold-out updates.
* On registration/activation: the store email address, admin email address, store currency, site domain and the contact details entered in the activation form (name, company, email, phone, country) are sent to create the store account.
* On every listing or detail page load (when not cached): the selected filters, currency and product IDs are sent to fetch inventory.
* When a ring is built, added to cart or ordered: the diamond ID, event type and a session ID are sent for usage statistics.
* When the plugin is uninstalled: the store owner name, company name and email are sent so Keyideas is notified of the uninstall.
Service provided by Keyideas Infotech Pvt. Ltd.: Terms, Privacy Policy.

Keyideas RingBuilder app and Feed Center (https://ring-builder.apps.keyideasglobal.com)
Once the store is connected, provides the diamond and gemstone inventory, prices, product details and recommendations shown in the ring builder: on every listing or detail page load (when not cached), the shop name, store token, selected filters, currency and product IDs are sent to fetch inventory.
* When an order with a ring builder stone is paid: the shop name, the stones’ stock numbers, the order item IDs and the WooCommerce product IDs are sent, so the sale shows in the Feed Center’s Sales dashboard.
The Feed Center link in the plugin dashboard opens the Keyideas RingBuilder app’s Feed Center in a new browser tab, signed in to your store. The plugin connects your store to the app on its own; no sign-up form is shown.
* To connect the store (after activation, when an administrator opens the dashboard or the Feed Center, until the store is connected): the site URL, the site name, the administrator email address and country from the activation form, the store currency and the plugin version are sent. The first time, the app creates the store’s account with them.
* With that request, until the store has its admin key: a random one-time code is sent to get the key, which signs the sign-in token. The app sends the key, with that code, to this site’s REST route /kirb/v1/admin-secret, which only keeps a key that comes with the code it issued.
* When the administrator opens the Feed Center: the shop name and a short-lived signed sign-in token are sent in the Feed Center link.
Service provided by Keyideas Infotech Pvt. Ltd.: Terms, Privacy Policy.

Keyideas demo product server (https://keyideasglobal.com)
Only used to import demo ring setting products. A request is made to download the demo product list and images; no site data is sent.
Terms, Privacy Policy.

geoPlugin (http://www.geoplugin.net)
Used on the plugin activation form in the admin dashboard to pre-select the administrator’s country. The administrator’s IP address is sent when the activation form is displayed.
Terms and Privacy Policy.

Google Fonts (https://fonts.googleapis.com)
The Poppins and Assistant fonts are loaded from Google Fonts on the ring builder pages, and so are the heading fonts chosen in Appearance → Typography (only when one is chosen; the default inherits the theme’s font). Google receives the visitor’s IP address and browser information.
Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Brevo Meetings (https://meet.brevo.com)
The plugin dashboard (activation form, Premium Features and Contact Us) links to a Brevo booking page for a free consultation. Nothing is sent unless the administrator clicks the link and books a meeting.
Terms of Use, Privacy Policy.

Keyideas forms service (https://apps-manager.apps.keyideasglobal.com)
Renders the Contact Us form in the plugin dashboard and the optional feedback form shown when the plugin is deactivated.
* Contact Us: the details the administrator enters are sent when they submit the form.
* Deactivation feedback: the form is only loaded when the administrator clicks “Deactivate” for this plugin. Only if they submit it, the chosen reason, any text they type, the administrator’s email address and the site URL are sent. “Skip & deactivate” sends nothing.
Service provided by Keyideas Infotech Pvt. Ltd.: Terms, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 9.0 or higher, then upload the diamond-ring-builder-jewelry folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory (or install it from Plugins → Add New)
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Open Keyideas Jewelry Customizer in the admin menu and follow the Setup Guide: choose your stones and ring collection in Settings, your colors and languages in Appearance, and your margins in the Feed Center. Add the “Start with…” page links to your menu and you’re done!
sections.faq:
What type of jewelry stores can I create?

Here are some examples of what you can sell with the ring builder: engagement rings, fine jewellery such as earrings and pendants, loose natural diamonds, lab-grown diamonds, colored diamonds and gemstones. Stores using it include dimendscaasi.com, bongioielli.com and ramziandco.com.au.

What plans are available?

Four plans: Free, and the Pro plans Basic, Standard and Premium.

  • Free ($0, free forever): ring, earring and pendant builders, AI diamond score, sample diamonds in place of Nivoda, 30% of your own imported diamonds, Ask AI with 20 messages a month. The Keyideas logo is shown.
  • Basic ($49 per month billed yearly, or $69 monthly): 50% of the diamonds from every supplier, including Nivoda and your own, Ask AI with 40 messages a month, Advanced CSS on the yearly plan, and the Keyideas logo can be removed for $330 one-time.
  • Standard ($99 per month billed yearly, or $119 monthly): 70% of the diamonds, Ask AI with 60 messages a month, Advanced CSS on the yearly plan, and the Keyideas logo can be removed for $230 one-time.
  • Premium ($121 per month billed yearly, or $145 monthly): 100% of the diamonds, Ask AI with 100 messages a month, Advanced CSS on the yearly plan, and no Keyideas logo.

Every plan includes diamond suppliers, grid view on mobile and redacted certificate PDFs; show/hide filters and engraving are free on every plan for a limited time. Your plan is shown on the Plan page in the plugin.

What is the difference between Free and Pro?

Free includes the complete 3-step ring builder, Add to Cart with WooCommerce checkout, the Feed Center, CSV import (30% of imported stones shown), the sales dashboard, Appearance and Language & Region, with sample diamonds in place of Nivoda.

The Pro plans (Basic, Standard and Premium) add live Nivoda inventory (a Nivoda account is needed) and show more of all your diamonds: 50%, 70% or 100%. They also add more Ask AI messages, Advanced CSS on yearly plans and the option to remove the Keyideas logo. See “Plans: Free vs Pro” above, or Compare Free vs Pro.

Is there a free trial?

No. Instead of a time-limited trial, every store starts on the Free plan, which never expires. Move to Basic, Standard or Premium whenever you need more diamonds or features.

How do I upgrade or change my plan?

Use Contact Us in the plugin, book a free consultation or email sales@keyideasinfotech.com. Our team sets the plan for your store, and the Plan page in the plugin shows it.

Can I import my own diamonds and gemstones?

Yes, upload a CSV file in the Feed Center. Your plan sets how many of the stones you import are shown: 30% on Free, 50% on Basic, 70% on Standard and all of them on Premium. Start from a template: natural.csv, lab.csv, colored.csv, gemstones.csv.

Where do the ring settings come from?

From your own WooCommerce products. In Settings → Display Diamonds & Gemstones → Select Ring Collection, choose the product category that holds your ring settings, or create one.

Need designs? The Product Library add-on offers 100+ engagement and wedding ring designs with 360° videos (digital assets only; manufacturing and fulfillment stay with you).

Can I match the ring builder to my brand?

Yes, in Appearance you set your primary and accent colors and the heading and subheading fonts, then click Preview in New Tab to see the storefront with your unsaved changes. Pro adds layout styles and custom CSS.

Can I change the storefront language and text?

Yes, the storefront can be shown in English (US), English (UK), French, German, Italian or Spanish. In Appearance → Language & Region, turn on your languages and set the default one. To change any text, click Download next to a language, edit the Translation column of the CSV, Upload it and save Appearance.

How do I set ring sizes for my region?

In Appearance → Language & Region → Select Ring Size, choose your region’s standard (for example United States–Mexico–Canada). Click Edit to add or remove sizes, separated by commas.

How do I order a diamond a customer bought?

Each WooCommerce order shows the stock number of the stone, and the ring setting for rings built in the ring builder. For Nivoda stones, order from Nivoda with that stock number (a Nivoda account is needed). RapNet, VDB and other suppliers can be connected with the Custom Supplier Integration add-on.

Will thousands of diamond products hurt my SEO?

No, diamond products, their categories and the ring builder pages are marked noindex, nofollow automatically. If another SEO plugin such as Yoast or Rank Math still lists them, set the kirb-* diamond product categories to noindex and leave them out of its sitemap.

The diamond or ring pages show “page not found”. What do I do?

Go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save Changes. If the ring builder still does not look right with your theme, contact us from Contact Us in the plugin and our team will help with theme-specific adjustments.

How much does Pro cost? Do you offer refunds?

Basic is $49 per month billed yearly ($588) or $69 monthly, Standard is $99 per month billed yearly ($1,188) or $119 monthly, and Premium is $121 per month billed yearly ($1,452) or $145 monthly. The Free plan costs nothing. There is a one-time setup fee of $550-$1,000 depending on your store. Because setup includes server, account and feed configuration, we do not offer refunds after payment, so please try the free version first. See plans and pricing

Where can I find out more information?

For more information please check out the Keyideas Jewelry Customizer documentation and the video tutorials. For help, use Contact Us in the plugin, book a free consultation or email sales@keyideasinfotech.com.

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the Keyideas Jewelry Customizer plugin by email to sales@keyideasinfotech.com with the subject “Security”, and not in the public support forum. Our team will verify the report and release a fix.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • New: Free plan stores show a sample set of natural, lab-grown, colored diamonds and gemstones in place of Nivoda, each with a “Sample” tag on the listing and the diamond detail page
  • New: The Feed Center lists the sample stones as Sample Inventory, ready to use with no setup
  • Improvement: Redesigned Plan page: a summary of your plan (share of diamonds, Ask AI messages left this month, Keyideas logo, Advanced CSS) and a Compare all plans table
  • Improvement: The Compare all plans table shows your own diamonds (uploaded inventory) and Nivoda diamonds (Nivoda account needed) as separate rows
  • Fix: 360° videos open in their video-only view, without the viewer’s error page
  • Fix: Saving the stone type switches in Settings no longer waits for the app’s cache to clear

1.3.0

  • New: Renamed to Keyideas Jewelry Customizer. The plugin slug, settings and features stay the same
  • New: Appearance page with brand colors, heading and subheading typography, and Language & Region (languages, default language, ring size standards and CSV translations of the storefront text)
  • New: Preview in New Tab shows your unsaved colors, fonts and translations on the storefront, only to you, until you save
  • New: The Feed Center opens in a new tab, signed in securely, with a loading animation while it opens
  • New: Stores connected to the Keyideas RingBuilder app get their diamond data from it, and paid orders show in the Sales dashboard
  • New: Plans: Free and three paid plans, shown on the Plan page; a store’s plan sets the share of diamonds shown, the Keyideas logo and the Ask AI messages
  • New: Settings > Add-ons switches on the add-ons in your plan: Grid View on Mobile, Show/Hide Filters, Hide Certificate Number, AI Diamond Score, Pendant Builder, Earring Builder (matched pairs), Add Diamonds From Your Suppliers, Ask AI and Add Engraving
  • Improvement: The diamond listing, detail and review pages follow your brand colors
  • Improvement: Settings shows evenly sized stone type tiles, and Appearance lists the Pro appearance options
  • Improvement: Phone and tablet layouts of the plugin dashboard, and the same page width on every dashboard page

1.2.16

  • Redesigned the diamond listing, diamond detail, ring setting and ring review pages.
  • Fixed activation output, settings save warnings and rewrite rules after activation.
  • Coding standards, escaping and security improvements for WordPress.org.
  • Add to Cart and WooCommerce checkout for loose stones and rings built in the ring builder.
  • Feed Center, CSV import and the sales dashboard are now available in the free version.
  • The plugin now has its own WordPress admin menu, with a submenu item for each dashboard section.
  • Redesigned admin dashboard with a plugin header, a Premium Features tab and better phone and tablet layouts.
  • Declared compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Redesigned the Contact Us page with a new contact form, pre-filled from your store’s contact details.
  • Removed the Video Tutorials and FAQs tabs and the live chat widget from the dashboard.
  • Added a “Read Documentation” link on the My Plan page and a RingBuilder 2.0 section on the Premium Features tab.

1.2.0 – 1.2.15

  • Renamed the plugin to “Keyideas RingBuilder – Jewelry” (1.2.5)
  • Security fixes, SEO and search engine crawling fixes, and diamond listing filter fixes
  • Review notice, UI improvements, performance improvements and stability fixes

1.1.0 – 1.1.6

  • New: Italian language support
  • New: Diamond virtual try-on on the diamond detail page, opening with the diamond’s shape and carat
  • New: Teal gemstones
  • Improvement: Faster caching with much lower server resource usage
  • UI, performance and bug fixes

1.0.0 – 1.0.6

  • Initial release (1.0.0)
  • New: Two more diamond shapes
  • Faster plugin activation, UI fixes on the listing and detail pages, and performance improvements
